title: Hydraulic fluid power - Pressure control valves (excluding pressure relief valves), sequence valves , unloading valves, throttle valves and check valves- Mounting surfaces
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14148) covers Hydraulic fluid power - Pressure control valves (excluding pressure relief valves), sequence valves , unloading valves, throttle valves and check valves- Mounting surfaces. Tliis Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 5781 : 2000 'Hydraulic fluid power — Pressure-reducing valves, sequence valves, unloading valves, throttle valves and check valves — Mounting surfaces' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the and approval of the Medical Instruments, General and Production Engineering Division Council. This standard was first published in 1 994 by adopting ISO 5781 : 1 987 'Hydraulic fluid power — Pressurecontrol valves (excluding pressure-relief valves ), sequence valves, unloading valves, throttle valves and check valves — Mounting surfaces'. The ISO Standard has since been revised as ISO 5781 : 2000. To align the standard with international practices, the sectional committee, dealing with the subject, decided to revise by adopting ISO 5781 : 2000 as Indian Standard under dual numbering system.
